Install Hermes — hands on

# Where Things Live {.sdaia-dark background-gradient="linear-gradient(135deg, #1C355E, #00C9A7)"}

A quick, non-scary tour

## It's All Just Files in a Folder {auto-animate=true}

::: {.incremental}
- **Your files** — the documents and data for the work
- **Your standing instructions** — `CLAUDE.md` (the wall note — Session 6)
- **Your saved Skills** — reusable recipe cards (Session 7)
- **Your Memory** — the agent's notebook about you (Session 8)
:::

. . .

::: {.callout-tip}
## Nothing is magic
Every "feature" you'll learn this week is just a **file in this folder** that the app
re-sends to the brain. That's the whole trick.
:::

# Agent-Era Safety {.sdaia-dark background-gradient="linear-gradient(135deg, #FF7A5C, #1C355E)"}

The second rule

## One Rule Was Enough — Until Now {auto-animate=true}

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
::: {style="background: #f7f9fc; padding: 1.2em; border-radius: 12px; border-left: 4px solid #1C355E;"}
**Rule 1 — Newspaper Test**

Guards what you *paste **in***.

*(Day 1)*
:::
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
::: {.fragment .fade-in}
::: {style="background: #f7f9fc; padding: 1.2em; border-radius: 12px; border-left: 4px solid #FF7A5C;"}
**Rule 2 — Blast Radius**

Guards what the agent ***does***.

*(today)*
:::
:::
:::
::::

. . .

::: {style="text-align: center; margin-top: 0.5em;"}
The Newspaper Test never saw this coming — nothing got *pasted*; the agent **acted**.
:::

## Blast Radius & Human-in-the-Loop {auto-animate=true}

::: {data-id="blast" style="background: #1C355E; color: #ffffff; padding: 1.2em; border-radius: 12px; text-align: center; font-size: 1.05em;"}
Before letting an agent act, ask:
*"What's the worst it could do if it's wrong — and who'd notice in time?"*
:::

. . .

::: {.callout-important}
## Always start in draft / notify-me mode
The agent **proposes, you approve**. Promote to **act-on-its-own** only after it has
proven itself.
:::

## Our Course Rule {auto-animate=true}

::: {style="background: #00C9A7; color: #ffffff; padding: 1.5em; border-radius: 12px; text-align: center; font-size: 1.2em;"}
All hands-on agent work runs in a **sandbox folder** with **dummy data**.
:::

. . .

::: {style="text-align: center; margin-top: 0.5em;"}
A mistake can't touch real work while you're learning.
:::

# Build: Your First Agent Run {.sdaia-dark background-gradient="linear-gradient(135deg, #1C355E, #00C9A7)"}

Watch it work across files

## Give It a Real (Sandboxed) Task {auto-animate=true}

::: {.callout-tip}
## Hands-on
Point Hermes at the **sandbox folder**, then give it one end-to-end task — e.g.
*"Read these three files and produce one summary."*
:::

::: {.incremental}
- Watch it **open files**, not just chat
- Watch it **run steps** in order
- It **proposes** the result — you stay in the loop
:::

# Micro-Check {.sdaia-dark background-gradient="linear-gradient(135deg, #1C355E, #9B8EC0)"}

Which mode?

## Quiz — Act Now or Propose & Wait? {auto-animate=true}

**1.** "Reformat these notes into a clean summary in a new file."

. . .

::: {.fragment .fade-in}
::: {style="background: #00C9A7; color: white; padding: 0.8em; border-radius: 12px; text-align: center;"}
**Act now** — low blast radius, easy to undo.
:::
:::

. . .

**2.** "Send the follow-up emails to the client list."

. . .

::: {.fragment .fade-in}
::: {style="background: #FF7A5C; color: white; padding: 0.8em; border-radius: 12px; text-align: center;"}
**Propose & wait** — irreversible, high blast radius. Review first.
:::
:::

## Key Takeaways {.sdaia-dark background-color="#1C355E"}

::: {.incremental}
1. **Agent ≠ chat** — it opens files, runs steps, and can act
2. **The working directory is the office** — your context as real files in a folder
3. **It's all just files** — `CLAUDE.md`, Skills, Memory live there; nothing is magic
4. **Second safety rule** — blast radius / human-in-the-loop guards what it *does*
5. **Draft first** — propose-and-wait before act-on-its-own; sandbox + dummy data
:::
